name: Devil, Hellish Fog
body:
Hellish Fog Devil CR 8

XP 4,800
LE Huge outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)
Init +11; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+7 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural, –2 size)
hp 105 (10d10+50)
Fort +11, Ref +14, Will +8
DR 10/good; Immune fire, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10; SR 18

OFFENSE

Speed fly 80 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +17 (2d6+6)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks engulf (DC 17, 2d6 acid)

STATISTICS

Str 22; Dex 25; Con 18; Int 13; Wis 19; Cha 11
Base Atk +10; CMB +18; CMD 38
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Mobility, Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +23, Knowledge (planes) +12, Perception +15, Stealth +12

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Hell)
Organization solitary or cloud (2-4)
Treasure none

The fog devil (also known as devil fog), is an evil mist that sweeps in and destroys the enemies of the Lords of Hell.

Devil fog is detectable by the stench of sulfur and the fact that everything inside of the fog devil is dissolved by vile acid.

A fog devil is 25 feet across, and has little tangible weight. It is more akin to a sentient evil cloud than a physical body, and can sometimes be mistaken for an air elemental until a Knowledge (planes) test is successful (DC 18).

The intents of a devil fog are never in doubt, as they exist to devour and destroy mortal beings. Devil fog will specifically seek out air elementals in preference to other targets if given the chance due to a long-standing grudge.
